svg.title: How to read the Fauske vent-sizing nomograph
svg.text: How to read the Fauske vent-sizing nomograph
Vent area per 1000 kg of reactants, m²
labels at the line ends; L/D = 400 (ψ = 0.5), 20% overpressure
Mark the self-heat rate (dT/dt)ₛ at the set temperature.
Go up to the set-pressure line (interpolate between lines).
Go across to the left axis.
Read the vent area per 1000 kg; multiply by the reactant mass (in 1000 kg); correct for ψ and overpressure.
Redrawn from Crowl & Louvar Fig. 9-9 (Fauske 1984): lines computed from A = m q/[2ψ(Tₛ/Cₚ)^½ ΔP], water-like properties,
Cₚ = 2.33 kJ/kg K, ΔP = 0.2 Pₛ; in the exam read the printed nomograph — values may differ slightly.
